senses.en: to record in a journal or diary; (accounting) to enter a transaction in a journal
senses.zh: 記入日記；（會計）記入日記帳

ex.en: Accountants must journalize every sale before posting it to the ledger.
ex.zh: 會計人員必須先把每筆銷售記入日記帳，再過到分類帳。

root.note: 寫進每日的紀錄 → 記入日記（帳）

senses.en: to fight on horseback with lances; to compete or argue closely
senses.zh: （騎士）馬上長槍比武；較量；爭論

senses.en: a contest between two knights on horseback with lances

ex.en: The two candidates will joust over tax policy in tonight's debate.
ex.zh: 兩位候選人將在今晚的辯論中就稅務政策交鋒。

senses.en: cheerful and friendly

ex.en: Our jovial neighbor always greets us with a joke and a wave.
ex.zh: 我們那位快活的鄰居總是笑著揮手跟我們說笑。

root.note: 古人認為在木星下出生的人個性開朗 → 快活的

senses.en: a feeling of great happiness and triumph

ex.en: There was jubilation in the streets when the home team won the championship.
ex.zh: 主隊奪冠時，街頭一片歡騰。

parts.m: shout for joy 歡呼（拉丁文 jubilare）

root.note: 高聲歡呼 → 歡欣鼓舞

senses.en: the ability to make sensible decisions
an opinion or conclusion; a decision of a court

ex.en: I trust her judgment because she always thinks before she acts.
ex.zh: 我信任她的判斷力，因為她總是三思而後行。

parts.m: judge 判斷（jus 法 + dic 說）

root.note: 做出判斷 → 判斷力；判決

senses.en: the administration of justice; the judiciary as a whole
senses.zh: 司法；司法行政；（總稱）法官、司法機關

ex.en: The reform changed how the courts of judicature were organized.
ex.zh: 這項改革改變了各級司法法院的組織方式。

senses.en: relating to courts of law or judges

ex.en: The new law will face a judicial review before it takes effect.
ex.zh: 這項新法在生效前將接受司法審查。

root.note: 說出法律的裁決 → 司法的

mn: judicial（司法的）和 judicious（明智的）容易混淆：cial 看法院，cious 看腦袋。

senses.en: the judges of a country considered as a group; the court system

ex.en: An independent judiciary is essential to a healthy democracy.
ex.zh: 獨立的司法體系對健全的民主至關重要。

parts.m: 名詞字尾（相關的人或機構）

root.note: 宣告法律的機構 → 司法部門

senses.en: having or showing good judgment; wise and sensible

ex.en: A judicious use of color can make a simple room feel warm.
ex.zh: 巧妙地運用色彩，能讓簡單的房間感覺溫暖。

root.note: 做出像法官一樣的判斷 → 明智的

senses.en: to keep several objects in the air by throwing and catching them
to manage several activities at the same time

ex.en: Many students have to juggle part-time jobs and schoolwork.
ex.zh: 許多學生必須同時兼顧打工和課業。

senses.en: the art of juggling; trickery or deception

ex.en: The company's profits were just financial jugglery designed to fool investors.
ex.zh: 這家公司的獲利只是用來欺騙投資人的財務把戲。

senses.en: one of the large veins in the neck; the most vulnerable point
relating to the neck or throat

ex.en: The debater went for the jugular by exposing his opponent's contradictions.
ex.zh: 那名辯手直攻要害，揭露了對手的前後矛盾。

parts.m: collarbone, throat 鎖骨、喉部（拉丁文 jugulum）

root.note: 喉部的 → 頸靜脈 → 要害

mn: 片語 go for the jugular：直攻要害、狠狠攻擊。

senses.en: full of juice
interesting because scandalous or exciting
senses.zh: （八卦、細節）有趣的；引人入勝的

ex.en: She bit into a juicy peach on the hot afternoon.
ex.zh: 在炎熱的午後，她咬了一口多汁的桃子。

senses.en: a point where two or more things, such as roads or railways, meet
senses.zh: 交叉點；交會處；（鐵路）樞紐站

ex.en: Turn left at the junction and the museum will be on your right.
ex.zh: 在路口左轉，博物館就在你的右手邊。

senses.en: a particular point in time or in a series of events, especially a critical one

ex.en: At this juncture, we need to decide whether to continue the project.
ex.zh: 在這個關頭，我們必須決定是否繼續這個計畫。

root.note: 事件連接的點 → 關鍵時刻

senses.en: a military group that rules a country after taking power by force
senses.zh: （政變後掌權的）軍政府；軍事執政團

ex.en: The junta suspended the constitution and banned all opposition parties.
ex.zh: 軍政府廢止了憲法，並禁止所有反對黨。

parts.m: join 聯合（西班牙文 junta 會議）

root.note: 聯合起來的團體 → 軍事執政團

mn: 源自西班牙文，j 唸成 h 的音；美式也常唸 [ˋdʒʌntə]。

senses.en: relating to the law or the administration of justice

ex.en: A corporation is treated as a juridical person under the law.
ex.zh: 在法律上，公司被視為法人。

root.note: 宣告法律的 → 法律上的

senses.en: the official power to make legal decisions
the area or field over which that power extends

ex.en: The case falls outside the jurisdiction of the local court.
ex.zh: 這個案件不屬於地方法院的管轄範圍。

root.note: 有權說出法律裁決 → 管轄權

senses.en: the theory or philosophy of law; a body of court decisions

ex.en: She studied jurisprudence before becoming a constitutional scholar.
ex.zh: 她在成為憲法學者之前研讀法理學。

root.note: 關於法律的智慧 → 法理學

senses.en: a member of a jury

ex.en: Each juror must listen carefully to all the evidence before voting.
ex.zh: 每位陪審員在投票前都必須仔細聽取所有證據。

senses.en: a good reason or explanation for something

ex.en: There is no justification for treating customers so rudely.
ex.zh: 對顧客如此無禮是沒有任何正當理由的。

root.note: 使成為正當 → 正當理由

senses.en: relating to young people
childish or immature
a young person

ex.en: Pulling the chair away as a prank was a juvenile thing to do.
ex.zh: 惡作劇把椅子拉走實在是很幼稚的行為。

root.note: 年輕的 → 青少年的；幼稚的

senses.en: to place side by side, especially to compare or contrast

ex.en: The exhibit will juxtapose old photographs with modern images of the same streets.
ex.zh: 這次展覽會把同一條街的老照片和現代影像並排展示。

senses.en: a small item kept in memory of a person or event

ex.en: She kept her grandmother's ring as a keepsake.
ex.zh: 她把祖母的戒指留下來當作紀念。

parts.m: for the sake of 為了

root.note: 為了（某人）而保存 → 紀念品

senses.en: a square of cloth worn on the head or around the neck

ex.en: The farmer tied a red kerchief around her head to block the sun.
ex.zh: 那位農婦在頭上綁了一條紅頭巾遮陽。

senses.en: the soft inner part of a nut or seed; a grain of corn
the central or most important part of something

ex.en: There is a kernel of truth in every rumor.
ex.zh: 每則謠言都有幾分真實的成分。

mn: 常見片語 a kernel of truth：一點點真實成分。

senses.en: an oven for baking pottery or bricks, or drying things

ex.en: The potter placed the clay bowls in the kiln overnight.
ex.zh: 陶藝家把陶碗放進窯裡燒一整夜。

parts.m: cooking stove 爐灶（拉丁文 culina）

senses.en: a unit of volume equal to 1,000 liters

ex.en: The tank can hold about one kiloliter of water.
ex.zh: 這個水槽大約可容納一千公升的水。

senses.en: a unit of length equal to 1,000 meters

ex.en: The school is only one kilometer from my house.
ex.zh: 學校離我家只有一公里。

mn: 美式也常唸 [kəˋlɑmətɚ]，兩種都常見。

senses.en: a unit of power equal to 1,000 watts

ex.en: This space heater uses about one kilowatt of electricity per hour.
ex.zh: 這台電暖器每小時大約耗電一千瓦。

senses.en: a long, loose traditional Japanese robe with wide sleeves

ex.en: She wore a silk kimono to the summer festival in Kyoto.
ex.zh: 她穿著絲質和服去參加京都的夏日祭典。

senses.en: having a kind and sympathetic nature

ex.en: A kind-hearted teacher stayed late to help me with math.
ex.zh: 一位好心的老師留下來幫我補數學。

senses.en: a petty or minor king (often used with contempt)

ex.en: Each local kingling claimed to be the rightful ruler of the whole island.
ex.zh: 每個地方小王都自稱是全島的正統統治者。

senses.en: the position, power, or rule of a king

ex.en: The young prince was not yet ready for the burdens of kingship.
ex.zh: 年輕的王子還沒準備好承擔王位的重擔。

senses.en: a person's relatives; family members

ex.en: He traveled to the village to visit his kinsfolk during the holiday.
ex.zh: 他在假期時到村裡探望親戚。

senses.en: dishonest or deceitful behavior

ex.en: The merchant's knavery was finally exposed when his scales were checked.
ex.zh: 當商人的秤被檢查時，他的詐欺行為終於曝光。

senses.en: to press and fold dough or clay with the hands
to massage by squeezing with the hands

ex.en: You need to knead the dough for ten minutes before letting it rise.
ex.zh: 要先揉麵團十分鐘，再讓它發酵。

mn: k 不發音，跟 need 同音：揉麵團需要（need）用力。

senses.en: a small decorative object of little value

ex.en: Every shelf in her house was covered with a knickknack from her travels.
ex.zh: 她家裡的每個架子上都擺著旅行帶回來的小擺飾。

senses.en: the rank or title of a knight

ex.en: The scientist received a knighthood for her contributions to medicine.
ex.zh: 這位科學家因對醫學的貢獻而獲頒爵士頭銜。

senses.en: requiring a lot of time and effort

ex.en: Copying every record by hand was a laborious process.
ex.zh: 用手抄寫每一筆紀錄是很費力的工作。

root.note: 需要大量勞動 → 費力的

senses.en: a complicated network of paths in which it is hard to find the way
something very complicated or confusing

ex.en: The old city is a labyrinth of narrow streets and alleys.
ex.zh: 舊城區是一座由狹窄街道和小巷組成的迷宮。

mn: 源自希臘神話中囚禁牛頭人的迷宮。

senses.en: to tear or deeply cut the skin
to hurt someone's feelings deeply

ex.en: Broken glass can lacerate your feet, so wear shoes on the beach.
ex.zh: 碎玻璃可能會割傷你的腳，所以在海灘上要穿鞋。

senses.en: lacking enthusiasm and determination; carelessly lazy
senses.zh: 無精打采的；懶散的；不起勁的

ex.en: His lackadaisical attitude toward practice cost him a spot on the team.
ex.zh: 他對練習散漫的態度讓他失去了隊上的位置。

mn: 來自古語 lackaday（唉呀），整天唉聲嘆氣 → 無精打采。

senses.en: the production of milk by mammals to feed their young

ex.en: Nursing mothers need extra calories during lactation.
ex.zh: 哺乳中的母親在泌乳期間需要額外的熱量。

senses.en: relating to or like milk
a lymph vessel in the small intestine that absorbs fats

ex.en: Each lacteal in the small intestine absorbs digested fats.
ex.zh: 小腸中的每條乳糜管都負責吸收消化後的脂肪。

root.note: 像乳汁的 → 乳的；乳糜管

senses.en: relating to or obtained from milk

ex.en: Lactic acid builds up in your muscles during hard exercise.
ex.zh: 劇烈運動時，乳酸會在肌肉中堆積。

senses.en: (chiefly Scottish, informal) a boy or young man

ex.en: "Come in out of the rain, laddie," said the old fisherman.
ex.zh: 「小伙子，進來躲雨吧。」老漁夫說。

senses.en: a large, deep spoon with a long handle for serving soup
to serve with a ladle

ex.en: Use the ladle to serve the soup into each bowl.
ex.zh: 用湯杓把湯舀到每個碗裡。

senses.en: a person or thing that is slower than others
slow and lagging behind

ex.en: Once a laggard in technology, the country is now a leader in electric cars.
ex.zh: 這個國家曾是科技落後者，如今卻在電動車領域領先。

root.note: 落在後面的人 → 落後者

senses.en: a person who owns or rents land
senses.zh: 地主；土地所有人；土地承租人

ex.en: Each landholder had to pay a tax based on the size of the farm.
ex.zh: 每個地主都要依照農地大小繳稅。

senses.en: a person who rents out land, a house, or an apartment

ex.en: Our landlord finally agreed to fix the leaking roof.
ex.zh: 我們的房東終於同意修理漏水的屋頂。

senses.en: an object or feature that is easy to see and recognize
an event or discovery marking an important stage

ex.en: The court's decision was a landmark in the history of civil rights.
ex.zh: 法院的這項判決是民權史上的里程碑。

senses.en: all the visible features of an area of land
the general situation in a particular field

ex.en: Smartphones have completely changed the media landscape.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機徹底改變了媒體生態。

senses.en: slow and relaxed; lacking energy
senses.zh: 慵懶的；無精打采的；緩慢的

ex.en: We spent a languid afternoon lying by the pool.
ex.zh: 我們在泳池邊躺著，度過一個慵懶的下午。

root.note: 虛弱無力的 → 慵懶的

senses.en: a pleasant feeling of tiredness or laziness
an oppressive stillness of the air

ex.en: The summer heat filled the town with a sleepy languor.
ex.zh: 夏天的酷熱讓整個小鎮瀰漫著昏昏欲睡的慵懶。

senses.en: a brief failure of concentration, memory, or judgment
an interval of time
to gradually pass into a worse state; to expire

ex.en: A momentary lapse in attention caused the accident.
ex.zh: 一時的疏忽導致了這場意外。

senses.en: feeling or showing strong, offensive sexual desire

ex.en: The critic condemned the film for its lascivious scenes.
ex.zh: 評論家譴責這部電影有淫穢的情節。

senses.en: (chiefly Scottish, informal) a girl or young woman

ex.en: The old woman smiled and called the girl a bonny lassie.
ex.zh: 老婦人笑著說那女孩是個漂亮的小姑娘。

senses.en: the state of existing but not yet being active or visible
(computing) the delay before data transfer begins

ex.en: Online gamers complain whenever the network latency rises.
ex.zh: 只要網路延遲變高，線上玩家就會抱怨。

root.note: 隱藏的狀態 → 潛伏；延遲

senses.en: existing but not yet developed or visible

ex.en: The coach saw latent talent in the shy young player.
ex.zh: 教練在那位害羞的年輕球員身上看到潛在的天分。

senses.en: at a time in the future or after the time mentioned
coming after in time

ex.en: I'm busy now, so I'll call you back later.
ex.zh: 我現在很忙，晚點再回電給你。

senses.en: of, at, or toward the side

ex.en: Solving the puzzle required some lateral thinking.
ex.zh: 要解這個謎題需要一些跳脫框架的思考。

mn: lateral thinking：水平思考、跳脫框架的創意思考。

senses.en: somewhat late

ex.en: We had a latish breakfast after sleeping in on Sunday.
ex.zh: 星期天睡晚了，我們吃了頓稍晚的早餐。

senses.en: a structure of crossed strips with open spaces between them
a regular repeated arrangement of points, such as atoms in a crystal

ex.en: Roses climbed up the wooden lattice beside the door.
ex.zh: 玫瑰沿著門邊的木格架往上攀爬。

senses.en: to praise highly, especially in public

ex.en: Critics continue to laud the novel for its honest portrait of rural life.
ex.zh: 評論家持續讚揚這部小說真實描繪了鄉村生活。

senses.en: deserving praise

ex.en: Their goal of feeding every child in the city is laudable.
ex.zh: 他們讓全市每個孩子都能吃飽的目標值得讚揚。

senses.en: praise; the act of praising

ex.en: The retiring professor received warm laudation from her former students.
ex.zh: 這位即將退休的教授獲得昔日學生熱烈的讚揚。

senses.en: expressing praise

ex.en: The film received laudatory reviews from nearly every newspaper.
ex.zh: 這部電影幾乎獲得每家報紙的好評。

senses.en: a woman whose job is washing and ironing clothes

ex.en: In the novel, the laundress knows every family's secrets.
ex.zh: 在這部小說裡，洗衣婦知道每戶人家的秘密。

senses.en: a person given an award for outstanding achievement
a poet laureate, an official national poet

ex.en: A Nobel laureate will speak at this year's graduation ceremony.
ex.zh: 一位諾貝爾獎得主將在今年的畢業典禮上致詞。

root.note: 戴上月桂冠的人 → 得獎者

senses.en: (literary) to wash or bathe; (of water) to flow against

ex.en: She knelt by the stream to lave her tired face.
ex.zh: 她跪在溪邊清洗疲憊的臉。

senses.en: a person who draws up and establishes a code of laws

ex.en: Solon is remembered as the great lawgiver of ancient Athens.
ex.zh: 梭倫被譽為古雅典偉大的立法者。

senses.en: a person who makes laws; a legislator

ex.en: One lawmaker proposed a bill to lower the voting age.
ex.zh: 一位議員提出降低投票年齡的法案。

senses.en: not strict, careful, or severe enough
loose; not tense

ex.en: Security at the airport was surprisingly lax.
ex.zh: 機場的安檢出奇地鬆散。

senses.en: a medicine that helps the bowels empty
tending to loosen the bowels

ex.en: The doctor warned him not to take a laxative every day.
ex.zh: 醫生警告他不要每天吃瀉藥。

senses.en: (literary) an open area of grassy land; a meadow

ex.en: The cattle grazed slowly across the green lea.
ex.zh: 牛群慢慢地在綠色草地上吃草。

senses.en: a printed sheet of paper giving information, often free
a small leaf, part of a compound leaf

ex.en: Volunteers handed a leaflet to everyone who passed the station.
ex.zh: 志工們發傳單給每一位經過車站的人。

senses.en: a substance such as yeast that makes dough rise
to make something less serious or dull by adding something lively

ex.en: She tried to leaven the serious speech with a few jokes.
ex.zh: 她試著用幾個笑話來調劑這場嚴肅的演講。

root.note: 使（麵團）升起的東西 → 酵母

senses.en: on or toward the side sheltered from the wind
the side sheltered from the wind

ex.en: The boats anchored on the leeward side of the island to escape the storm.
ex.zh: 船隻停泊在島嶼的背風面以躲避暴風雨。

root.note: 朝向遮蔽處 → 背風的

senses.en: using the left hand more naturally than the right
(of a compliment) insincere or ambiguous

ex.en: My sister is left-handed, so she needs special scissors.
ex.zh: 我姊姊是左撇子，所以需要特製的剪刀。

mn: a left-handed compliment：明褒暗貶的話。

senses.en: something handed down from a predecessor or from the past
money or property left to someone in a will

ex.en: The civil rights movement left a lasting legacy of equal protection.
ex.zh: 民權運動留下了平等保護的長遠影響。

parts.m: law, send 法；派遣（拉丁文 legare 遺贈）

root.note: 依遺囑留下的東西 → 遺產

senses.en: to make something allowed by law

ex.en: Several countries have voted to legalize same-sex marriage.
ex.zh: 好幾個國家已投票通過同性婚姻合法化。

senses.en: a covering for the leg, usually from ankle to knee; (pl.) tight stretchy trousers

ex.en: The hiker wrapped a canvas legging around each calf to keep out snow.
ex.zh: 登山客在每隻小腿綁上帆布綁腿以防積雪滲入。

senses.en: clear enough to be read

ex.en: Please make sure your handwriting is legible on the exam.
ex.zh: 考試時請確保你的字跡清晰可讀。

senses.en: a soldier in an ancient Roman legion
relating to a legion

ex.en: Each Roman legionary carried heavy armor and tools on long marches.
ex.zh: 每個羅馬軍團士兵在長途行軍時都背著沉重的盔甲和工具。

root.note: 挑選出來組成的軍團的人 → 軍團士兵

senses.en: to make or pass laws

ex.en: It is difficult to legislate against every kind of online abuse.
ex.zh: 要立法禁止每一種網路霸凌是很困難的。

senses.en: having the power to make laws; relating to lawmaking

ex.en: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan votes on the national budget each year.
ex.zh: 台灣的立法院每年都要表決國家預算。

senses.en: a person who makes laws; a member of a legislature

ex.en: The legislator met with parents to discuss school safety.
ex.zh: 這位立委與家長們會面討論校園安全。

senses.en: the quality of being lawful, reasonable, or acceptable

ex.en: Protesters questioned the legitimacy of the election results.
ex.zh: 抗議者質疑選舉結果的正當性。

senses.en: allowed by law or rules
reasonable and justifiable
[lɪˋdʒɪtəˏmet] to make legitimate

ex.en: She had a legitimate reason for missing the meeting.
ex.zh: 她缺席會議有正當的理由。

senses.en: free time when one is not working

ex.en: She spends her leisure time painting and hiking.
ex.zh: 她空閒時畫畫和健行。

parts.m: be permitted 被允許（拉丁文 licere）

root.note: 被允許做自己想做的事的時間 → 閒暇

mn: 片語 at your leisure：在你方便的時候。

senses.en: the quality of being more merciful or tolerant than expected

ex.en: The judge showed leniency because it was the teenager's first offense.
ex.zh: 因為這是那名青少年初犯，法官從輕發落。

senses.en: not as strict or harsh as expected; merciful

ex.en: My parents are lenient about bedtime on weekends.
ex.zh: 週末時我爸媽對就寢時間比較寬鬆。

senses.en: like or relating to a lion

ex.en: The old conductor had a leonine mane of white hair.
ex.zh: 那位老指揮家有一頭像獅子鬃毛般的白髮。

senses.en: a lack of energy and enthusiasm

ex.en: Lack of sleep can cause lethargy and poor concentration.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足可能導致倦怠和注意力不集中。

parts.m: forgetfulness 遺忘（希臘神話忘川 Lethe）

root.note: 遺忘而懶散 → 昏睡、倦怠

senses.en: a bank built to prevent a river from flooding
(historical) a formal reception held by a monarch
senses.zh: （舊時君主的）早朝接見；招待會

ex.en: The levee broke during the hurricane and flooded the city.
ex.zh: 颶風期間堤防潰決，淹沒了整座城市。

senses.en: a bar used to move a heavy object by resting on a fixed point
a means of gaining power or influence

ex.en: Pull the lever to open the emergency exit.
ex.zh: 拉下操縱桿以打開緊急出口。

root.note: 舉起東西的工具 → 槓桿

senses.en: a huge sea monster; anything very large and powerful

ex.en: The tech company has grown into a leviathan that controls much of the market.
ex.zh: 這家科技公司已成長為掌控大半市場的龐然大物。

mn: 源自聖經中的海怪；霍布斯的名著《利維坦》用它比喻強大的國家。

senses.en: humor or lack of seriousness, especially when inappropriate

ex.en: His joke added a moment of levity to the tense meeting.
ex.zh: 他的笑話為緊張的會議帶來片刻輕鬆。

senses.en: to officially impose a tax, fee, or fine
a tax or fee that is imposed
to enlist soldiers for military service

ex.en: The city plans to levy a tax on plastic bags.
ex.zh: 市政府計劃對塑膠袋課稅。
